title.rendered: Budget Committee Vacancy – Now Accepting Applications

content.rendered:
Sherwood School District Budget Committee position #5 has become vacant mid-term due to the resignation of committee member Tina Brannan. The Board is currently seeking qualified applicants to fill this vacancy. The applicant selected will serve on the Budget Committee for the completion of the unfinished term, beginning March 21, 2024 and serving through June 30, 2025.

The Budget Committee plays a vital role in assisting the District and the community in reviewing the proposed budget each year before the proposal is presented to the Board for adoption. The Board invites interested community members to submit an application to be considered for appointment to the Budget Committee. Applications should be submitted to Christine Andregg, at the Sherwood School District Office, 21920 SW Sherwood Blvd, Sherwood, OR 97140, or by email to candregg@sherwood.k12.or.us, by 4:00 p.m. on March 11, 2024. Please click the link below for application (for fillable PDF version, please download the file after opening the link).
